I answered from the notes and type declarations included in your message, not from the files on disk, and I could not write the file because this session has no file-writing tool, so the JSON above is its content for you to save at `/home/dev/aa255f/app/notes/tighter-zoom.json`. The answers rest on note 37, which says a change to `limits` takes effect at the next yaw/pitch/radius write that changes the value, or at any center assignment. That means `asIs` and `radiusSelf` stay at 4000, while `centerSelf` clamps to 2000. I am least sure of `emptyOrientation`: I assumed `setGeospatialOrientation` assigns a new center object, as note 11 suggests, which would clamp it to 2000, but the declarations don't show its body. Since you can't run the library here, please confirm that value, and perhaps the `centerSelf` one, against the real 1.39.0 source before you rely on them.
